periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axes of the eye patches are oriented diagonally at approximately 45 degrees, sloping downward from the lateral edges toward the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval/ellipsoidal shape with a visual width-to-height ratio of approximately 1.4:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering where the lowest point of the patch is significantly lower than the geometric center.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band is thick, occupying approximately 40-50% of the visible vertical height of the lateral torso.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: A wide gap between the ears, roughly equivalent to double the horizontal width of a single ear region.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, semi-circular curvature at the apex with no visible flattening.
